hero.title: Run the whole school day in one place.
hero.subtitle: Attendance, timetables, grades, bus tracking, fees and messaging — connected in real time for parents, teachers, supervisors, drivers and administrators. In English, العربية and کوردی.

flagship.title: Not a generic CRM with a school skin.
flagship.subtitle: The features below are the ones a school touches every single day. Here's how they actually look.

schedule.title: Timetables that build themselves.
schedule.desc: Enter each teacher's weekly load once. Scholify generates a conflict-free timetable — no teacher, class or room double-booked — that you can still pin and rearrange by hand.

points.a: Auto-generate from teaching load, with room and availability constraints
points.b: Pin the lessons you like, regenerate the rest
points.c: Cover an absence with a substitute in a couple of clicks

bus.title: Parents always know where the bus is.
bus.desc: Drivers share live GPS while the trip is running. Parents watch the bus move on a map and get a heads-up before it reaches their stop — no more waiting at the gate guessing.

points.a: Location updates every 30 seconds during the trip
points.b: Proximity alerts at 10, 5 and 2 minutes, and on arrival
points.c: Each family sets its own pickup point on the map

grades.title: From daily marks to official report cards.
grades.desc: Every school defines its own mark types. Teachers file grades, admins publish per term, and Scholify turns the released marks into printable report cards and cumulative transcripts.

points.a: Admin-defined quizzes, exams and daily marks
points.b: Report-card and transcript PDFs in EN, AR and KU
points.c: Published per term — parents only see what's final

attendance.title: Attendance for students — and for staff.
attendance.desc: Teachers take the roll in a couple of taps. Employees clock in and out with a rotating QR code at reception, checked against the school's location, with automatic end-of-day close-out and simple leave.

points.a: Daily student roll with weekly summaries and full history
points.b: Staff clock-in via rotating QR + location check
points.c: Auto close-out at day's end, plus leave requests

features.title: The rest of what a school needs.
features.subtitle: One system instead of a drawer full of spreadsheets, group chats and paper files.

chat.title: Chat & meeting invites
chat.desc: Parents and teachers message directly — and a supervisor can propose a meeting right inside the conversation, which the parent confirms in a tap.

homework.title: Homework & assignments
homework.desc: Post work, attach files, track submissions. Parents see what's due tonight, not what was due yesterday.

academic.title: Academic portal
academic.desc: A separate space for rich lesson posts and ebooks. Teachers publish, families read, everything stays searchable.

health.title: Student health & safety
health.desc: A clinic record with a nurse-visit log, plus the allergies and conditions teachers need to know — sensitive notes encrypted, staff-only.

hr.title: Employee records
hr.desc: Contracts, documents and salaries in one HR file per employee, with sensitive personal data encrypted at rest.

clearance.title: Roles & clearance
clearance.desc: Give each administrator exactly the powers they should have — finance, HR, health, academics — no more, no less.

fees.title: Tuition & accounting
fees.desc: Invoices, payments, receivables aging and a proper ledger — the money side of the school, not just the classroom.

login.title: Secure sign-in
login.desc: Optional phone or email one-time codes on top of the password, plus recovery codes — protection without locking people out.

portals.title: One source of truth, seen from every seat.
portals.subtitle: Each role gets its own portal — only what they need, and everything they need.

parent.title: Parents
parent.desc: Live bus tracking, attendance, grades, homework, report cards and chat with teachers.

teacher.title: Teachers
teacher.desc: Attendance, grading, homework, timetables, weekly summaries and student briefs.

supervisor.title: Supervisors
supervisor.desc: Attendance oversight, student reports, weekly reviews and parent meetings.

driver.title: Drivers
driver.desc: Route and student list, start/stop trip, automatic live location sharing.

admin.title: Admins
admin.desc: Classes, users, timetables, features and announcements — the whole school from one panel.

accountant.title: Accountants
accountant.desc: Tuition, invoices, payments, expenses and financial reports.

reception.title: Reception
reception.desc: Appointments, visitor check-in and the staff attendance desk.

staff.title: Staff
staff.desc: Any employee can clock in and out and manage their own leave.

mobile.title: The same system, on the phone.
mobile.subtitle: Parents, teachers, supervisors, drivers and staff carry Scholify with them — the same real-time data, dark mode, and full support for English, Arabic and Kurdish.

security.title: Student and family data, handled seriously.
security.subtitle: A school holds some of the most sensitive data there is. Scholify is built accordingly.

tenant.title: Every school isolated
tenant.desc: Multi-tenant from the ground up — one school can never see another's students, staff or records.

encryption.title: Sensitive data encrypted
encryption.desc: Health notes and personal employee data are encrypted at rest with a per-school key, not stored as plain text.

mfa.title: Multi-factor sign-in
mfa.desc: Phone and email one-time codes plus recovery codes protect accounts, without locking anyone out of their child's data.

audit.title: Every action logged
audit.desc: Sensitive changes are written to an audit trail, so administrators can always see who did what, and when.
